content: {"features": [{"name": "cooling_extrap_6h_c", "formula": "t2m_1800_c + 6 * cooling_rate_1500_1800_c_per_h", "category": "radiative_cooling", "rationale": "Extrapolates late-afternoon cooling trend six hours to approximate midnight temperature."}, {"name": "soil_air_excess_c", "formula": "stl1_1800_c - t2m_1800_c", "category": "radiative_cooling", "rationale": "Warmer soil than air stores daytime heat that slows nocturnal radiative cooling."}, {"name": "dry_clear_index", "formula": "log1p(max(dewpoint_depression_1800_c, 0)) * afternoon_clearness", "category": "humidity_deficit", "rationale": "Dry air combined with clear afternoon amplifies nocturnal radiative heat loss."}, {"name": "calm_dry_index", "formula": "max(3 - wind_1800_ms, 0) * dewpoint_depression_1800_c", "category": "wind", "rationale": "Calm winds below 3 m/s limit mixing while dry air enhances radiative cooling."}, {"name": "clear_sky_persist", "formula": "afternoon_clearness * max(1 - sky_emissivity_1800, 0)", "category": "cloud", "rationale": "Sustained clear skies from afternoon to evening maximize overnight longwave loss."}, {"name": "lw_drop_afternoon_evening", "formula": "strd_afternoon_mean_wm2 - strd_1800_wm2", "category": "cloud", "rationale": "Falling longwave from afternoon to evening signals clearing skies and stronger cooling."}]}
